scripts.build:framework: npm run build -w @nineh-fe-base/mf-vite -w @nineh-fe-base/mf-core && npm run build -w @nineh-fe-base/ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,auth,products -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shell" "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w products-service"
